root: ^It's your second day. You're in the meeting, mentally preparing to deliver a technical solution you spent half the night perfecting. You're ready. You're confident. You're about to crush it. Your turn is next.
^"Hey, sweetie! Last minute change. You're not presenting anymore."
^"Yeah... we need a note taker for the meeting. You can do that for us, right?"
^I spent all night preparing? What should I do?
^Insist that you present your assigned task

c-0: ^"Sure... I guess I'll just... take notes."
c-1: ^"Actually, I'd really like to present. I've prepared extensively."

pushback_reaction: ^Boss stares at you like you just asked to fly the plane.
^"Cute. Linda, you'll be presenting. You — take notes. We don't have all day."
notetaking: ^You sit at the corner of the table, laptop open, typing furiously. No one looks at you.
^The meeting flashes forward. Linda presents. You take notes.
^The meeting starts to wrap up. The team is talking casually now.
lunch_suggestion: ^"How about we grab some sonion rings??"
^The room goes quiet. Everyone stares at you, straight-faced. You are ignored.
^"Hey, Boss... how about we grab those onion rings you like?"
^Just once in my life, I'd like to go an entire day without having a bruh moment.
